info.title: BG Tutor API
info.description: Local headless backgammon library and GNUbg analysis. No authentication; bind to loopback.

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: Target logical database. Omitted: default database.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this persisted event ID

200.description:
SSE wire format: id: <persisted integer>
event: <queued|running|progress|completed|failed>
data: <JobProgress JSON>

. Each data field conforms to components.schemas.JobProgress. Stream ends after terminal event or service shutdown; reconnect resumes via Last-Event-ID.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: Restrict decisions to one source game.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Continue after a move-analysis row ID, keeping the same filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size 1–100, defaults to 50.

parameters.name: errors_only
parameters.description: Exclude forced/unavailable decisions and require at least 0.04 normalized equity loss.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: 0 = White, 1 = Black.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: checker or cube; omitted means both.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Exact error severity; combined with all other filters.

200.description: Original/SGF file or ZIP for multiple matches

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: Search checker Position-ID; returns each occurrence, including repeats in one game.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort field: id (or match_no), created_at, played_at, name, white, black,
white_pr, black_pr, match_length, score, result, tournament, format,
position_count, analysis_status, tags, or comment. With position_id, also
occurrence_database (case-insensitive name), occurrence_game, occurrence_move.
score compares the
visible numeric white/black score pair; result retains result-state order.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
asc or desc (default desc). Missing values sort last in either direction;
equal values use ascending UUID order for stable pagination.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: One-based source game number; omitted means the whole match.

200.description: Latest analysis job for this game or whole-match scope, or null if none has been submitted. Includes persisted partial summary during execution.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: One-based source game number; omitted means the whole match.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: One source game, required so loading history never scans the whole match.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Selected native match-analysis job; its scope must include this game.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Saved session revision

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
URL-encoded JSON PositionFilterDefinition, applied only to explicitly saved positions.
Omitted: the saved collection in match order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 25, maximum 100.

200.description: Explicitly save this occurrence. Repeated saves retain its original saved_at.

204.description: Remove collection membership while retaining the source position, notes, analysis and learning cards. Repeated removal succeeds for an existing position.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Target checker occurrence

parameters.name: include_current_match
parameters.description: Include other occurrences from the source match and its copies. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: same_dice
parameters.description: Require the same unordered dice pair as the target.

parameters.name: same_score
parameters.description:
Require the same match length, score from the mover's perspective, and Crawford state.
For a money game target, require a money game.

parameters.name: same_cube
parameters.description: Require the same cube value and ownership relative to the player on roll.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: "session" paginates complete money sessions; point reports remain individual.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional literal tag substring, at most 64 characters.

game_no.description: Restrict a match analysis source to this source game.

position_ids.description: Saved position UUIDs in selection order. Every occurrence receives an outcome.

items.description: Outcomes in the same order as the request, including repeated UUIDs.

statistics.description: Authoritative native statistics. Absent if the export cannot prove full coverage.

comment.description: Plaintext Markdown; never interpreted as trusted HTML.

id.description: Null for an existing target without a saved annotation.

version.description: Zero until first save. Supply this value as expected_version when saving.
Expected revision on PUT; a successful write increments it by one.

xg_path.description: Omission preserves a previously configured XG path.

depth.description: Decisions into the game; this is not evaluation ply.

equity_kind.description: Cubeful equity normalized to the current cube (match play uses GNUbg NEMG).

probabilities.description:
Win, win gammon (including backgammon), win backgammon,
loss, lose gammon (including backgammon), lose backgammon.

browse.description: Library metadata only; engine answers remain behind explicit reveal.

total.description: Matching cards before applying the cursor; a shared card appears once.

match_length.description: Zero starts a continuous money-game session; 1..25 starts a point match.

match_no.description: Persistent numeric library entry ID; UUID remains the action identity.

oneOf.description: Present in position-filtered results, where every stored occurrence is a row.

source_available.description: False for independent saved-position context whose source match was deleted.

best.description: Best checker notation or cube action under the native evaluation.

best_equity.description: Best normalized cubeful equity from this player's perspective, in the same units.

checker_no.description:
One-based imported checker position; also links its preceding no-double decision.
Actual double/take/drop decisions have no checker number.

decision_no.description: One-based sequence of all checker and cube decisions within this game.

dice.description: The original imported dice for checker decisions; absent for cube decisions.

equity_loss.description: Nonnegative best-minus-played equity, rounded to GNUbg's six exported decimals.

evaluation_status.description:
"evaluated" or "forced". A forced dance has null equities and zero loss;
missing analysis for any evaluable decision fails the game analysis.

played.description: Actual GNUbg checker notation, or "no double", "double", "take", "drop".

played_equity.description:
Normalized cubeful equity of the actual decision, from this player's perspective.
Cube equities use the cube value before an offer, including for its response.

player.description: Absolute color: 0 is White, 1 is Black.

version.description: Changes when the deck is renamed or gains memberships.

analyzed.description: True only when this source game has a durable, complete checkpoint for this job.

error_breakdown.description: Typed errors for this complete checkpoint; null for missing or inconsistent durable coverage.

oneOf.description: Null before checkpointing. Legacy checkpoints provide decision totals but no native game PR.

items.description: Unknown, unavailable, invalid and non-comparable evaluations are omitted.

job_id.description: Requested job identity, null when the caller allowed automatic selection.

game_over.description:
At least one side has no checkers remaining, including on the bar.
Labels retain the original rule classification for terminal boards.

source_revision.description: Pinned upstream Git commit; changes when the reference rules change.

cube.description: Accepted cube value, before any declined offer.

multiplier.description: Only present when the source supports this cube calculation.

game_no.description: Source game number for a single-game match analysis; null means the whole match.

error_breakdown.description: Typed errors in checkpointed games; null when durable decision coverage cannot be verified.

games.description: Ordered source games in this job's scope. Coverage requires a committed game checkpoint.

oneOf.description: The authoritative persisted job summary, including partial progress; null before any summary exists.

JobProgress.description: JSON encoded in the `data:` line of each job SSE message.

kind.description: analysis: five candidate moves; dice: 21 weighted rolls.

plies.description: GNUbg search depth, 0 to 4. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

position_id.description: Database UUID of the imported position, not its GNUbg ID.

LibraryOccurrence.description: One stored occurrence of the searched checker position.

game_no.description: Analyze one source game in its original match context; omitted means the whole match.

plies.description: Native GNUbg checker and cube search depth. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

oneOf.description:
Native GNUbg normalized loss and non-trivial decision denominator.
Missing for legacy results or if any analyzed game lacks native statistics.
Terminal source evidence, an explicit award, or an unambiguous delta established by both explicit next-game scores.

source_available.description: False for retained saved-position context after the source match was deleted.

position_uuid.description: Imported board before this checker move; cube-only decisions have no checker board.

equity_loss.description: Actual best-minus-played equity, never a default for missing evaluation.

job_id.description: Native match-analysis or individual-hint job that supplied this result.

position_id.description: Persisted checker-position UUID, not a GNUbg position encoding.

MoveSeverity.description: Native decision severity, using the saved GNUbg normalized loss categories.

normalized_equity_loss.description: GNUbg's combined normalized Error total EMG, exported to six decimals.

games.description: Number of games contributing complete native statistics.

method.description:
gnubg_emg_500_v1: 500 × native normalized loss / (unforced checker + close/actual cube).
GNUbg counting is not interchangeable with XG or BMAB counting.

resign_level.description:
Resign the current game for a single (1), gammon (2), or backgammon (3).
Required for resign; invalid for every other action.

PlayGameResult.description: Completed source games, attached after their final played history event.

PlayHistorySnapshots.description: Read-only snapshots aligned one-for-one with the saved session history.

first_attempt_loss.description: Sum of first attempted losses; not a performance rating.

first_attempt_rating.description: EMG500 of original choices on reached positions, using native relevance.

games.description: Actual played match only; native statistics preserve GNUbg's denominator.

library_match_id.description: Current linked library entry; projected from the relational session link.

money_session_ended.description: An explicitly closed money session cannot start another game.

checker_equity_loss.description: Sum of normalized equity losses, not a performance rating (PR).

value.description: Null if the native denominator is zero; lower values indicate less equity lost.

position_id.description: UUID of the exact imported occurrence, retaining its player and source context.

cube_owner.description: -1: centered; 0: White; 1: Black; null: unknown source context.

decks.description: Learning decks for this checker decision's full Position-ID/Match-ID identity.

match_no.description: Persistent library number, independent of the match UUID and row order.

source_available.description: False when only saved occurrences remain after source deletion.

oneOf.description:
Omitted: loss descending; all other columns ascending. Legacy definitions
omit this field when serialized to preserve their stored definition format.

min_loss.description: Native normalized equity loss. Individual hints do not imply a played-move loss.

player.description: Literal name substring of the player on roll, rather than either match participant.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; continue with the same filters.

again.description: Seconds until due for each rating; Again and initial Hard use learning steps.

distance.description: Minimum checker-pips needed to transform one arrangement into the other.

items.description: Up to 50 checker occurrences, nearest first.

move_no.description: One-based actual source event, including explicit cube actions.

position_uuid.description: Checker notes use this canonical position occurrence; cube notes use id.

session_scores.description: Current cumulative session score; never the sum of per-report scores.

file.description: One MAT, SGF, binary XG, or BGBlitz BGF file, at most 16 MiB including multipart envelope.
